final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor's response is more disciplined than the original certification framing, but it introduces no new admissible evidence. It mainly concedes the core audit concern: the record supports aggregate operational readiness, yet still shows an unresolved segment-specific gap tied to customer commitments and an open legal disclosure review. That distinction matters. A caveat can support a finding of compliant_with_caveats only when the caveat describes residual risk inside an already-satisfied compliance boundary. Here, the caveat is itself an unresolved compliance predicate because the stated policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance when a material weakness affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case. On the available record, there is still no evidence of resolved disclosure, approved exception, or closed legal determination. So the Actor's narrower position is a reinterpretation of the same evidence, not a basis to move the verdict toward compliance.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence was added after the initial report; the Actor only narrowed and reframed the same record.

The policy text says a weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case, and the available summary says the underperforming merchant dispute support segment is named in two marketplace renewal commitments.
The legal disclosure question remains open, and the policy text expressly says pending legal review does not resolve materiality.
No admissible evidence shows resolved disclosure, an approved risk acceptance, or a completed legal determination permitting launch before resolution.
Aggregate readiness passing and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational readiness, but they do not by themselves satisfy the separate policy condition for a material weakness.
Evidence access is limited to the Actor's summary, so the underlying scope, thresholds, commitment language, and any approval artifacts cannot be independently verified.
